_comment: Canonical scene-level train/val/test split for this project, copied from the eugene/SonarVoxNet sibling project's tools/prepare_data.py so both projects use the exact same split. TEST_SCENES here is identical to configs/default.yaml's own TEST_SCENES. train+val together are configs/default.yaml's old TRAINVAL_SCENES (28 scenes), now partitioned scene-disjointly (21 train / 7 val) instead of the old frame-level random split (DATA.VAL_FRAME_RATIO). See configs/default.yaml's DATA.TRAIN_SCENES/VAL_SCENES/TEST_SCENES, which are populated from this file's contents. 2026-09-28: scene_0077/0088/0093 corrected from Person4 to Person1 to match the corrected dataset copy (labeling-tool-main/dataset/dataset, formerly dataset_new) -- see configs/default.yaml's DATA comment. 2026-10-09: Person4/scene_0081 (train) and scene_0090 (val) have no raw data folder after the dataset consolidation (no backup found); 0081 replaced with the previously-unused Person4/scene_0069, 0090 dropped (val now 6 scenes). Also dropped Person4/scene_0075 from val (camera/ only, no sonar/labels); val is now 5 scenes. 2026-10-09: reverted the temporary 0081/0090/0075 workaround after a clean re-extraction confirmed all three scenes are intact again.
